evidence: The Phoenix Dance, known in Vietnamese as Múa Phượng, is a mesmerizing performance that captivates audiences at the Thăng Long Water Puppet Theatre, situated on Đinh Tiên Hoàng Street, adjacent to the picturesque Hồ Gươm in Hanoi. Since the theatre's inauguration in 1969, this dance has emerged as a symbol of peace and tranquility, embodying the historical legacy of the city's ancient name, Thăng Long, which was bestowed upon it by King Lý Thái Tổ when he relocated the capital here in the early 11th century.
